description: Sidewinder edition pack for public-sector careers: public-works craft, permitting and inspection navigation, emergency-management coordination, and doing more with constrained budgets. A team+skill pack in Chauncey's sense: field how-tos for the craft itself, career-skill entries for refining craft and leveling up, and team-play entries for coordinating crews, improvising together under pressure, and training each other. Lawful only; regulatory boundaries are named in stop conditions.
name: Governmental
notes_for_main_builder: Draft manifest for the editions framework to validate. Prerequisite graph is internal to this pack (governmental-* ids only). Team-play entries use the coordination-challenge adaptation of the schema (mechanism_check = the coordination challenge; improvised_tools = roles, rituals, lightweight processes). Titles were hand-deduped; validation script confirms.
safety_posture: Lawful only: regulatory boundaries are named in stop conditions, never crossed - appropriations are hard limits, licensed trades stay licensed.
Licensed work (electrical, plumbing, and other regulated trades) is diagnose-and-assist only for unlicensed crew; cross-training never authorizes freelancing.
Emergency procurement and emergency authority are narrow, documented, and auditable - genuine emergencies only.
Life-safety work (structural, fire, electrical reviews; known hazards) never waits for budget convenience.
No entry authorizes falsifying, backdating, or destroying public records.

track_emphasis.build: secondary - emergency communication trees, intake systems, temporary service points, mutual-aid requests
track_emphasis.combine: secondary - interagency coordination, cross-training, hybrid crews and departments
track_emphasis.create: secondary - SOPs, portfolios, training curriculum, new-hire onboarding systems
track_emphasis.improve: primary - budget stewardship, process refinement, career leveling, mentoring, after-action discipline
track_emphasis.improvise: primary - constrained-resource fieldwork, emergency response, short-crew operations, improvised command
track_emphasis.restore: primary - public-works repair, service restoration after facility failures, deferred-maintenance triage
